description: The bar chart illustrates the effect of different multilingual BERT models on various linguistic categories, as measured by a specific metric. The horizontal axis represents the linguistic categories, which include IE-Romance, IE-Slavic family, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis indicates the effect, measured in a numerical scale, with values ranging from 0 to 30. Each bar represents a different model, with the following colors and labels: mBERT-R2 (green), XLM-R2 (blue), mBERT-B2 (red), and XLM-B2 (pink). The bars are arranged in a grouped manner, with each group corresponding to a linguistic category. The height of each bar indicates the effect of the model on that particular category, with error bars representing the variability or confidence interval of the measurements. The chart does not include any sorting or emphasis on specific bars, and the values are not explicitly labeled on the bars.
